name: Quickswap V3
rootCause: Decentralized exchange Quickswap has come under attack for a vulnerability in its hosting provider GoDaddy. The hijackers gained access to QuickSwap's DNS through a vulnerability in GoDaddy, where QuickSwap domains were hosted. Some DEX users lost around $107,600 through platform swaps before QuickSwap was able to regain control of our domain.

descriptions.text: Decentralized exchange Quickswap has come under attack for a vulnerability in its hosting provider GoDaddy. The hijackers gained access to QuickSwap's DNS through a vulnerability in GoDaddy, where QuickSwap domains were hosted. Some DEX users lost around $107,600 through platform swaps before QuickSwap was able to regain control of our domain.

QuickSwap’s frontend domain was hijacked through its GoDaddy-managed DNS configuration on 2022-05-14. Attackers redirected users to a modified QuickSwap interface that routed swap proceeds to attacker-controlled addresses. QuickSwap reported approximately $107,600 in user losses before regaining control of the domain and migrating DNS hosting. Attackers gained control of QuickSwap’s DNS records through a compromise of the protocol’s GoDaddy-managed domain account. The malicious frontend altered swap behavior so users interacting with the cloned interface sent assets to attacker-controlled addresses instead of receiving legitimate swap outputs.
